query: CBN warning fraudsters fake BVN NIN update SMS Nigeria
answer: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) has issued a warning against fraudulent messages regarding Bank Verification Numbers (BVN). These messages falsely claim that accounts will be deactivated for incomplete BVN registration and aim to obtain personal details to defraud account holders. The CBN explicitly states that neither they nor banks will ever request passwords, card details, or PINs via phone, email, or text. Customers are advised to visit banks in person for any issues requiring disclosure of personal information. The sources also mention that scammers send emails or SMS claiming account blocking due to incomplete BVN registration or new CBN policies.

query: fake credit alert scam Nigeria POS vendor how it works
answer: The sources describe a scam involving fake credit alerts in Nigeria, particularly targeting Point of Sale (POS) vendors. Scammers create convincing fake images or alerts to make it appear as though a transfer or payment has occurred when it hasn't. They may send multiple alerts or edited screenshots to appear legitimate. A common scheme is reversal fraud, where a POS agent receives a transfer via a card or phone transaction but then reverses it. The sources advise POS agents and business owners to never release goods based solely on an SMS or screenshot and to always confirm the payment themselves. Links in messages are highlighted as a red flag for potential scams. The sources do not provide specific dates, names, or official contact information related to these scams.
